## Intent

Explain the concrete need and link the relevant requirement, ADR, milestone or issue (`Fixes #n`).

## Changed behavior

Describe what the change enables or changes and any material limitations.

## Constraints touched

Name the `AGENTS.md` rules and ADRs this change touches (world data, layer separation, reuse, measurement conditions) and how it keeps them, or "none".

## Evidence

List commands and actual outcomes. Identify device/build/profile details for runtime claims. State relevant checks not run and why. Link benchmark evidence for performance claims.

## Sensitive paths

Does this change a sensitive path in the `AGENTS.md` profile, or anything else its Delivery section sends to independent review (public interfaces, credentials, setup, CI or release configuration, agent policy, rule-changing docs)? If yes, an independent review is recorded on this PR against the reviewed head before merge; a later push needs a new review.

## Decisions

Note ADR or development-guide updates. Open follow-up work as an issue.
